values: Overview of feature readiness per module
Create your account, log in, and set up your profile
Understand your home screen, BMI card, progress ring, and menu
Build your weekly workout plan and browse the exercise library
Launch a live session, track reps/time, and use the GPS map
Save your session stats and attach progress photos
Read your charts, switch metrics, and view fitness trends
Ask the AI for advice, get personalised cardio guidance
Join the Feed, create Groups, and climb the Leaderboard
Unlock badges, spend coins in the shop, and customise avatar
Edit your profile, manage notifications, and privacy options
Tap the Fitness Buddy icon on your home screen
The splash screen with the Fitness Buddy logo. If you have logged in before, you will be sent straight to the Dashboard after 1.5 seconds.
If you see the Dashboard immediately, your session is still active — no need to log in again.
The Login screen opens with fields for email and password.
Go to the Sign Up screen
Tap 'Sign Up' at the bottom of the Login screen
The Sign Up screen with an Email field and a Password field.
Tap the Email field and type your email address
Your email appears in the field.
Use a valid email — you will need it to reset your password later.
Tap the Password field and type a password
Firebase requires a minimum of 6 characters. Use a mix of letters and numbers.
Account is created and the app moves to the Setup Profile wizard.
If you see a red error toast, the email may already be in use — try a different one.
Enter your email and password, then tap 'Login'
If correct, you are taken directly to the Dashboard. If incorrect, a Toast error message appears.
Tap 'Reset Password' in Settings if you have forgotten your password.
SETUP PROFILE WIZARD (5 pages — tap Continue to advance)
Fill in: Full Name, Username (@handle), Bio (optional). Tap 'Continue'
Progress bar advances to 20%. Page 2 slides in.
Your username will appear on the Leaderboard and Community Feed.
Fill in: Age, Weight (kg), Height (cm), Target Weight (kg). Tap 'Continue'
Progress bar moves to 40%. Page 3 slides in.
These values are used to calculate your BMI and calorie estimates.
Fill in: Daily Step Goal, Daily Calorie Goal, Active Minutes Goal. Tap 'Continue'
Progress bar moves to 60%. Page 4 slides in.
A good starting step goal is 8,000 steps per day for beginners.
Tap the day chips to select days (Mon–Sun). Tap 'Continue'
Selected day chips highlight. Progress bar moves to 80%.
These days are highlighted on your Training Program calendar.
Tap the Activity Level spinner, choose a level, tap 'Finish & Start'
Button briefly shows 'Saving…' then takes you to the Dashboard.
Be honest — this helps the AI Chatbot give you accurate cardio guidance.
Tap the Home icon (house) in the bottom navigation bar
The main Dashboard screen with your name, BMI card, and activity ring.
The Dashboard updates in real time — data refreshes every time Firebase sends new information.
Look at the BMI card at the top of the screen
Your BMI number and a status label (e.g. 'Healthy', 'Overweight').
BMI is calculated from the weight and height you entered during setup.
Look at the circular activity ring and horizontal progress bar
A percentage and text showing steps to next milestone.
When you reach your step goal, the ring fills completely and shows 'Milestone reached! 🏆'.
Scroll down to the achievements list
A horizontal list of up to 5 recent achievement badges you have earned.
Tap an achievement to see full details in the Achievements screen.
Tap any of the 5 icons: Dumbbell · Robot · House · Chart · People
The selected screen opens. The tapped icon turns the primary brand colour.
The nav bar stays visible on every main screen.
Tap the hamburger icon (≡) in the top-right of the header bar
A popup menu: Edit Profile · Settings · Logout.
Edit Profile' opens Health Metrics in edit mode.
Tap 'Edit Profile' in the side menu
The Health Metrics screen opens pre-filled. Update and tap 'Update Data'.
Update your weight regularly — keeps your BMI and calorie estimates accurate.
You are signed out and returned to the Login screen.
Your data is saved in Firebase — logging out does not delete anything.
Tap the Dumbbell icon in the bottom navigation bar
The Training Program screen with a date header and a horizontal calendar.
Swipe left or right on the calendar row
The calendar snaps in 7-day week blocks spanning 2 years (104 weeks total).
The calendar jumps to the nearest Sunday boundary — this is intentional.
Tap any day tile in the calendar row
The selected day tile highlights. The exercise list updates for that day.
Tap today's date to return to the current day's schedule.
Add an exercise to a date
Select the target date, then tap the blue '+' floating action button
The Exercise Library opens in Selection Mode.
The selected date is passed to the Library — exercises you pick will be assigned to that day.
Choose an exercise from the Library
Tap any exercise card in the Library
The Exercise Description screen opens showing name, category, intensity, equipment, and demo image.
Add the exercise to your plan
Tap 'Add to Calendar' on the Exercise Description screen
You are returned to Training Program. The exercise now appears for the selected date.
You can add as many exercises as you like to one day.
Delete an exercise from the plan
Swipe the exercise row to the left
A delete action is revealed. The row is removed and deleted from Firebase.
This only removes the exercise from that date — it does not delete it from the Library.
The full Exercise Library opens in Browse Mode with all cardio exercises.
In Browse Mode, tapping an exercise opens its details — no exercise will be added to your plan.
Tap the search bar and type a keyword (e.g. 'jump rope', 'cycling')
The list filters in real time to show only matching exercises.
You can search by exercise name or category name.
Tap the Filter icon → select chips → tap 'Apply'
The exercise list updates to show only matching exercises.
Tap 'Reset' in the filter sheet to clear all filters.
Exercise Description screen shows: Name, category, intensity badge, equipment, tracking type, demo image.
Tracking Type' tells you how the live session will log this exercise.
Launch a workout from your plan
In Training Program, tap an exercise → tap 'Start Exercise'
The Live Exercise Session screen opens with two tabs: Stats and a dynamic tool tab.
The tab label changes based on the exercise type set in the Library.
Four live counters: Steps · Timer · Distance · Calories.
The step counter uses your phone's built-in sensor. Keep the phone in your pocket or hand.
Tap the Start button in the Stats area
Timer begins counting up. Tap again to pause.
Steps are counted whether the timer is running or not.
TAB 2 — DYNAMIC TOOL (changes by exercise type)
Tap the 'Log' tab → enter Weight and Reps → tap '+ Add Set'
Each set is saved in a scrollable list showing set number, weight, and reps.
You can log as many sets as needed. Sets are saved even if you navigate back to Stats.
Tap the 'Timer' tab → set target duration → tap 'Start Set'
A large countdown timer runs. A notification sounds when it reaches zero.
Tap 'Add Set' after each interval to log multiple timed sets.
Tap the 'Map' tab → grant location permission → tap 'Start Recording'
Your location appears on the map. A blue polyline traces your route in real time.
Stay outside with a clear sky for the most accurate GPS signal.
Tap the 'Done' tab → tap the checkmark when finished
A confirmation that the exercise has been marked complete.
Used for stretching or warm-up routines where tracking numbers is not needed.
The app compiles all data and automatically opens the Post-Workout Summary screen.
Do not close the app before tapping 'Finish Workout' — unsaved data will be lost.
This screen opens automatically after you tap 'Finish Workout'
A summary card: Exercise image or GPS map · Total Work · Average Level · Intensity · Active Time · Fastest Set.
Stats depend on exercise type — GPS shows distance/pace; strength shows volume/intensity.
Read the summary cards on screen
Total Work · Intensity · Active Time · Fastest Set — each defined on-screen.
These metrics are calculated from the sets and times logged during the live session.
Tap the photo add button / camera icon in the photo section
Your phone's photo picker opens. You can select up to 5 photos.
Photos are compressed and saved alongside your workout data in Firebase.
Tap the × button on any photo thumbnail
The photo is removed from the selection list.
You cannot add photos after saving — make your selection before tapping 'Save Workout'.
A saving indicator appears, then you return to the Dashboard. Your workout is stored in Exercise History.
Saving also awards fitness points, which appear on the Leaderboard.
A confirmation dialog appears. Tap 'Discard' to confirm, or 'Cancel' to go back.
Discarded sessions do not appear in history and do not award points.
Tap the Chart icon in the bottom navigation bar
The Progress Tracking screen with a line chart showing your Steps data for the current year.
Tap one of the three metric buttons: Steps · Minutes · Calories
The chart re-draws to show the selected metric.
Minutes' shows total active minutes per day — a good measure of consistency.
Tap one of the three timeframe buttons: Daily · Weekly · Monthly
The chart re-draws with the new grouping. X-axis labels update to match.
Monthly view is best for spotting long-term trends.
Tap the '+' or '−' buttons next to the year label
The chart shifts forward or backward one year.
Your full workout history is stored — you can go back to the start of your activity.
Tap any bar or point on the chart
A popup label appears showing the exact value and date.
Long-press on the chart to drag the selection across multiple data points.
The chart is captured as an image and the Android share sheet opens.
Great for sharing your consistency streak with friends or your coach.
Tap the 'Fitness Progress' shortcut from Progress Tracking
The Fitness Progress screen with tabs: GPS Map · Strength · Cardio.
Tap the tabs: GPS Map · Strength · Cardio
Stat cards, trend chart, and activity history list all update for the selected category.
Swipe left or right on the comparison card section
Side-by-side cards comparing different exercises or time periods.
Use these to identify which exercises you are improving at most.
Tap the Chart icon → tap 'Exercise History'
A monthly calendar grid highlighting days when you exercised, and a scrollable list below.
Tap '<' and '>' to navigate between months.
Tap the Robot icon in the bottom navigation bar
The Chatbot screen. On first visit: 'Kumusta! I am Fitness Buddy. How can we improve your health today?'
Previous conversations are automatically loaded from Firebase — history is preserved between sessions.
Tap the message input field and type your question
Your message appears as a blue bubble on the right side of the chat.
The AI is trained on cardio exercise and NCD topics. Questions outside this domain may not get helpful answers.
A 'Fitness Buddy is thinking…' bubble appears, then the AI's response replaces it.
Responses may take 5–15 seconds depending on your internet connection.
Type another message and tap Send
The conversation continues. The AI uses previous messages as context.
Ask follow-up questions like 'Can you give me a specific routine?' for more detail.
The AI uses your profile data
AI answers are personalised using your username, age, BMI, active minutes goal, and health conditions.
Keep your Health Metrics up to date so the AI gives you the most relevant guidance.
Tap the 'Clear Chat' button in the top header bar
A confirmation dialog: 'Delete all messages?' — tap 'Clear' to confirm.
Clearing chat is permanent. The AI will start a fresh greeting on your next visit.
When the keyboard opens, the bottom navigation bar hides automatically. It reappears when dismissed.
Tap anywhere outside the keyboard to dismiss it and restore the nav bar.
Tap the People icon in the bottom navigation bar
The Social screen with three tabs: Feed · Groups · Leaderboard.
Make sure the 'Feed' tab is selected
A scrollable list of posts: avatar, name, timestamp, caption, optional photo, and like count.
Tap anywhere on a post card
The Post Detail screen opens with all photos and a comment/reaction section.
Tap the avatar (emoji circle) on any post
That user's public Profile screen opens with display name, bio, badge, points, and level.
A 'Create Post' bottom sheet slides up with caption input, photo attachment, and 'Post' button.
Share a workout milestone, progress photo, or fitness tip.
Type your caption, optionally add a photo, then tap 'Post'
The bottom sheet closes. Your new post appears at the top of the Feed.
In the 'Discover' tab, find a group and tap 'Join'
The group moves to your 'My Groups' tab.
Tap the '+' floating button → fill in Group Name, Description, Privacy → tap 'Create'
Your new group appears in 'My Groups'. You are automatically the group Admin.
Public groups are visible in the 'Discover' tab.
Open a group and view tasks
Group Detail screen shows: Member list · Group feed · Task list with checkboxes.
Tap 'Add Task' → fill in name, description, deadline → tap 'Save'
The new task appears in the task list for all group members.
Use tasks to set group challenges like '30-minute walk every day this week'.
Tap the checkbox next to a task
The checkbox fills. Your completion status updates for all group members.
A podium showing Rank 1, 2, 3 with avatar, name, badge, and points. Below is the full ranked list.
Your own row is highlighted with a 'YOU' tag.
Points awarded for: Completing workouts · Unlocking badges · Engaging with community posts.
Consistency is key — saving a workout every day adds up faster than occasional big sessions.
Tap 'Achievements' from the Dashboard shortcut or the side menu
A grid of badges. Unlocked badges are in full colour. Locked badges are greyed out with a padlock.
Tap one of three filter buttons: All · Unlocked · Locked
The grid updates to show only the filtered results.
Check 'Locked' to see what goals you still need to hit.
Badges unlock at milestones: First workout · 7-day streak · 10,000 steps · 100 total workouts.
Each badge award also earns you fitness points.
Navigate to Avatar Customization from the Dashboard or rewards area
Your avatar in the preview area. Three tabs: Body · Head · Face. Coin balance shown at top.
The first item in each category is unlocked for free. All others cost coins.
Tap the Body, Head, or Face tabs. Tap 'ALL' to see all items, or 'UNLOCKED' for what you own.
A grid of avatar parts. Locked items show a coin price overlay.
A purchase dialog: 'Unlock [item] for [price] coins?' Tap 'Confirm' to buy.
If you do not have enough coins, a 'Not enough coins' Toast appears.
Tap an unlocked item to select it. Tap 'Save / Equip'
The avatar preview updates immediately to show your new look.
You can mix and match any unlocked Body + Head + Face combination.
(automatic — coins are awarded with workouts and achievements)
Your coin balance (shown at top of Customization screen) increases after each completed workout.
Coins are the in-app currency — the only way to earn them is through the app.
In the Social Hub, tap your own avatar, or navigate to Profile → tap 'Edit Profile'
The Edit Profile screen with your current Display Name, Bio, Avatar, Colour, and Featured Badge.
Tap the Display Name field, clear it, type a new name → tap 'Save'
Your new name appears on your profile, posts, and the Leaderboard.
Display Name is required — the Save button will not work if this field is empty.
Tap the Bio field, edit your text → tap 'Save'
Your new bio appears on your public profile.
Keep it short — it appears below your name on your profile card.
Tap any emoji in the Avatar grid
The avatar preview circle updates to show the selected emoji.
Tap any colour swatch in the colour grid
The avatar circle background changes to the selected colour.
Choose a colour that contrasts well with your chosen emoji.
Tap any badge in the Featured Badge grid (only unlocked badges are selectable)
The badge preview updates. This badge appears next to your name on profile and Leaderboard.
Unlock more badges through achievements to have more options here.
A brief saving indicator, then you return to your Profile screen with all changes applied.
Tap the hamburger menu (≡) on the Dashboard → tap 'Settings'
The Settings screen with your username, email (read-only), and toggle switches.
Switch turns on (blue) or off (grey). When on, the app sends reminders on your workout days.
Make sure notification permissions are granted for the app in your phone's Settings.
When on, the app notifies you if you have not logged a workout in more than 2 days.
Useful for keeping your streak and motivation going.
When Private is on, other users cannot view your profile or see your posts in the community feed.
The Leaderboard still shows your username and points even in Private mode.
Your username update and all toggle states are written to Firebase.
Firebase sends a password reset email. A Toast confirms: 'Password reset email sent'.
Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive within a few minutes.
Tap the hamburger menu (≡) → tap 'Edit Profile'
Health Metrics screen opens in edit mode. Update weight, height, goals, or workout days, then tap 'Update Data'.
Re-calculate your BMI after every significant change in weight.

values: How can a mobile health application be designed to provide a platform for Filipino non-gym-goers to overcome specific motivational barriers — lack of time, guidance, and training plan — that prevent them from adhering to a consistent cardiovascular exercise routine?

[Main Objective]
 
 Design and develop an adaptive, AI-driven mobile platform for Filipino non-gym-goers that leverages gamified engagement to overcome motivational barriers and deliver personalized cardiovascular training to promote consistent adherence and mitigate NCD risks.

Platform is focused exclusively on cardio-based exercises. Resistance training, strength-based plans, and sports-specific programs are NOT included.
 
 ML personalization is limited to user-provided inputs and in-app metrics only (no external wearable IoT sensor integration).

Training Program Module
  • AI-Generated Adaptive Plans (adjust based on performance history & goals)
  • Exercise Library with multimedia content
  • Workout Timer / Session Tracker
  • Completion Tracking with visual progress milestones
 
 Fitness AI Chatbot Module
  • AI Recommendation Engine (custom suggestions from user data)
  • Motivational Messaging & adaptive reminders
  • Integration with Training Program module
 
 Progress Tracking Module
  • Daily, weekly, and monthly trend charts
  • Statistical summaries (calories burned, active time)
  • Goal Attainment Monitor
 
 Dashboard Module
  • Performance Overview with dynamic visualizations
  • Quick Access Shortcuts
  • Data-driven 'Bits and Tips' section
 
 User Customization Module
  • Profile Configuration (demographics, health metrics, fitness goals)
  • Notification, reminder, and privacy settings
 
 Rewards & Leaderboard Module
  • Achievement Badges + points/ranking system
  • Leaderboard Display for friendly competition
 
 Group Fitness Challenge Module
  • Friend System with Performance Comparison
  • Community Rankings
  • Team Challenges

[Objective 1]
 
 Implement personalized goal-setting and progress visualization through an interactive cardio activity dashboard to enhance user motivation and engagement.
Dashboard and progress features are driven by user-inputted personal stats (e.g., BMI). Gamification layer (rewards, leaderboards) is included to drive behavioral consistency.

DASHBOARD (MODULE)
  • Personalized Goal-Setting Module
  • Intuitive Data Visualizations (progress charts, consistency tracking)
  • BMI-linked personalized goal display
  • WHO guideline-aligned progress indicators
 
 GAMIFICATION (MODULE)
  • Reward System (badges, points)
  • Competitive Leaderboards
  • Achievement-oriented experience design

[Objective 2]
 
 Provide an Adaptive Training System to generate personalized workout activities and user support, tailored to the user's real-time schedule and activity goal.
Machine learning model analyzes real-time progress, fatigue levels, and overall fitness status to auto-adjust intensity, duration, and type of workout. No human trainer required.

ADAPTIVE TRAINING SYSTEM (MODULE)
  • ML Algorithm for dynamic cardio plan generation
  • Real-time adjustment of intensity, duration, and workout type
  • Fatigue & fitness level analysis
 
 AI CHATBOT (MODULE)
  • Flan-T5 fine-tuned LLM (domain: cardio & NCD)
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Architecture
  • Keyword-based contextual search
  • Prompt Engineering layer
  • ROUGE-L evaluation (target F1-score ≥ 84%)
  • Negation Consistency Check (0% Polarity Violation Rate)
  • Out-of-domain query rejection (False Positive Rate control)
  • Gold Standard validation (3 categories: Psychoeducation, Risk Screening, Crisis Intervention)

[Objective 3]
 
 Integrate social elements like Community Rankings to increase user engagement and retention through an interactive and supportive in-app community.
Social ecosystem recreates gym-like accountability structures virtually. Supports peer-to-peer encouragement and collective goal-setting for non-gym-goers.

SOCIAL / COMMUNITY (MODULE)
  • Friend System (connect with peers)
  • Workout Group Formation
  • Community Challenges (collaborative)
  • Community Rankings display
  • Team Challenge participation
  • Peer-to-peer encouragement mechanisms

values: One pressing challenge is the limited opportunity for Filipino students to engage in reading comprehension practice beyond the classroom. As noted by Idulog (2023), Without accessible and engaging platforms to reinforce reading habits at home or in informal environments, students are unable to develop consistent reading routines or deepen their understanding through independent learning. This disconnect between in-school instruction and at-home reinforcement hinders the development of strong reading habits and foundational skills.
Integrates narrative-driven storytelling with interactive reading comprehension activities for Filipino students through a visual novel-style format.​

The application will focus on enhancing English reading comprehension through interactive, story-based gameplay. By embedding reading tasks into a visual novel and game format, the system will simulate immersive, real-life reading experiences in English that promote vocabulary acquisition, context interpretation, and inferencing. Additionally, these narratives drawing from English-translated Filipino storybooks, folktales, and familiar community settings, will naturally encourage cultural relevance and connection. This will enable learners to connect new English concepts to their existing cultural schema. This platform is intended to support second-language acquisition by increasing student motivation and engagement by combining entertainment with literacy learning that feel meaningful and relatable to Filipino students.

Moreover, traditional classroom materials, such as textbooks and worksheets, are often static, lacking the interactivity needed to encourage active reading. (DepEd, 2023; Dludla et al., 2024). This approach reduces students’ ability to engage critically with texts, especially when it comes to poetry and literature that require interpretation and deeper comprehension. The absence of multimedia tools, gamified learning elements, and scaffolded reading environments contributes to a passive reading culture, making it difficult for students to relate to or internalize complex texts. (Dludla, T., et al., 2024)

Implement interactive comprehension tasks where learners engage through various literary passages and excerpts such as poems, novels, and inspirational quotes to foster active reading and deeper understanding.

The application will incorporate a wide range of English-language texts, including literary excerpts, short poems, and thought-provoking quotations, tailored to the comprehension levels and grade levels of Philippine students. Additionally, these reading passages will be followed by structured tasks via drag and drop reading comprehension questions designed to assess literal, inferential, and critical understanding. This allows support of development in the core English reading skills such as skimming, scanning, context clue analysis, and text interpretation.

Furthermore, students often run out of meaningful practice materials, especially outside school hours, as current educational apps and modules usually offer a fixed set of questions, limiting continuous improvement. This limitation in available content leads to repetitive learning experiences, diminishing motivation and failing to address diverse learner needs across reading levels and interests. (PIDS, 2023)
Provide practice sets by utilizing an AI system to automatically generate reading prompts with relevant reading comprehension questions.

This mode offers continuous practice in English reading through AI-generated texts and comprehension questions. The AI-enabled system will curate reading materials across various genres and pre-set difficulty levels, ensuring learners have access to personalized, level-appropriate English content. By supplying limitless practice opportunities, this supports mastery through repetition, encourages independent learning, and helps address the scarcity of reading materials in traditional classrooms.

In addition, as students encounter difficulties in understanding complex prompts on their own, they do not have immediate access to a teacher or tutor outside of class to ask for assistance or get feedback on their work. As a result, students become discouraged when they cannot clarify confusing instructions or verify their answers, which ultimately slows down learning progress and affects confidence in comprehension tasks (Fitria, T.N., 2021).
Provide real-time, context-based hints and guidance to support learners in answering comprehension questions effectively by developing an AI companion.

The AI-enabled companion will act as a reinforcement for an intelligent support system that offers hints, definitions, and guidance in English to support learners as users answer comprehension questions. By providing timely, contextual feedback in English, the AI-enabled companion will help students better understand text structure, unfamiliar vocabulary, and nuanced meanings. The AI-enabled companion guidance is aimed at developing learner confidence, improving accuracy, and building independent reading strategies in English.
